name: Stamped
summary: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.
best_for: mid-market Shopify brands that want reviews and loyalty in one platform instead of juggling separate apps
skip_if: you're an early-stage store: our free install showed no reviews, and Reviews costs $23 a month at the 200-order step
honest_knock: The ladder climbs at every order step. Reviews runs from $23 a month at 200 orders to $799 on Unlimited, Repeat from $299 at 5,000 orders to $1,999, and crossing 5,000 orders doubles Reviews from $99 to $199. Loyalty is no longer priced on the pricing page, though the app's own plan screen sells it from $299 at 5,000 orders, while the FAQ still quotes $798 for multi-product access, so anyone buying more than one product depends on a sales quote. Stamped charges another $100 a month for each domain beyond the two included. Each additional store gets its first month free. Start with one product and price the step above the volume you actually expect.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month at the 200-order volume step (the free plan shows no reviews)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/product-reviews-addon and in our own test on a development store the same day; stamped.io/pricing read 16 November 2026 by plain fetch, the amount for each order step in the page's own HTML) Reviews starts at $23 a month for 200 orders, the bill follows monthly order volume per product, and the free plan a new install starts on does not show reviews on your store. The page now shows two product cards, Repeat and Reviews. Reviews is $23 a month at 200 orders, $99 at 1,000, $199 at 5,000, $399 at 20,000, $599 at 50,000 and $799 on Unlimited. Repeat shows no price at 200 or 1,000 orders and costs $299 at 5,000, $499 at 20,000, $999 at 50,000 and $1,999 on Unlimited. On 12 September 2026 the 5,000 step listed Repeat at $499 and Loyalty at $299 with a Multi-Product Bundle at $798, and every step from 20,000 up read "Custom plan — Talk to Sales". On 16 November there is no Loyalty card and no bundle card, while the FAQ on the same page still says plans start at $199 a month for a single product and $798 a month for multi-product access, and that all plans include unlimited orders. A pop-up offers 50% off a Stamped plan until the end of 2026, for new customers only and only after a call with the sales team. Plans include up to two domains, each additional store gets its first month free, and additional domains are $100/month each. Stamped's terms say fees exclude taxes. The page says nothing about overage charges. The Shopify listing, read 17 November 2026, shows four Reviews steps only: $23 for up to 200 orders a month, $99 for 1,000, $199 for 5,000 and $399 for 20,000. In our own test on 17 November 2026, a new install of the app started on a free plan, “Reviews (Lite)” at $0, with a banner saying “Upgrade your plan to process platform data and display reviews on site”: no products synced and no reviews could be shown. The app's plan screen sells Reviews from $23 up to $799 on Unlimited, and Loyalty on its own tab at $299 a month for up to 5,000 orders, $499 for 20,000, $699 for 50,000 and $899 on Unlimited. Shopify's approval screen for the $23 plan added an app spending limit of up to $56 per 30 days for charges based on use, and asked for a payment method; the plan screen says “Contact us to cancel”.
